updates.tweet_text: Trying to "get rich" in one day or 1 trade is what prevents most from ever doing so. There's 250 trading days a year. Wealth day trading is built taking a piece out via an edge daily & compounding it. Even 5 points *avg* daily on 1 ES contract is more than the average US salary
